statement: A running model, not a calibrated one, and thinner than the wisteria model it is derived from: there was no prototype of this plant to carry numbers over from, so most are copied from wisteria or are placeholders. None has been measured on a plant. Use its output to compare scenarios and to show what a design implies, not to predict dates, sizes or loads.

phenology.autumnColourDoy.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

phenology.leafFallDoy.basis: Loses most of its leaves over a UK winter. Dates are a placeholder.

phenology.floralInitiationDoy.basis: Buds are taken to form on the shoots of the year in early June. No dated source.

phenology.flowerOpenDoy.basis: Repeat-flowering: flowers open in succession across the RHS envelope of midsummer to autumn (1 July to 15 October).

phenology.petalFallDoy.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

phenology.flowerLastsDays.basis: How long one flower lasts. A placeholder.

extension.leaderMPerSeason.basis: RHS: grows up to 4.5 m, in a size band reached in 5 to 10 years. Not a growth rate; a placeholder of that order.

extension.lateralMPerSeasonByOrder.basis: Scaled down from the leader rate. Not measured.

extension.whipMPerSeason.basis: Each year the canes throw the flowering side shoots that carry the display. Rate is a placeholder.

extension.establishmentFactorByYear.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

architecture.trunkStemStartYears.basis: New canes from the base over the first three seasons. A placeholder.

architecture.nurseryCaneM.basis: A typical nursery plant. Not measured.

architecture.leaderLengthM.basis: RHS: grows up to 4.5 m. Used as a cap on cane length; a height is not a route length, so this is a placeholder.
